description: Turn a long video (stream, podcast, interview, gameplay VOD) into short vertical clips with captions using SnapDub, then pick the best ones, schedule them to TikTok, YouTube or Instagram, and find live paid clipping campaigns to submit them to. Use when someone wants clips from a YouTube, Twitch, Kick, Rumble or Zoom link, wants to run a clipping page or clip for Whop/Content Rewards campaigns, or asks which of their SnapDub clips to post first.
